query:
UPDATE subteam
            SET parent_id = $3
            WHERE team_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND (
                $3::uuid IS NULL OR (
                    $3 <> $2
                    AND EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM subteam parent
                        WHERE parent.id = $3 AND parent.team_id = $1 AND parent.parent_id IS NULL
                    )
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subteam child WHERE child.parent_id = $2)
                )
            )
